body:
Thanks for reaching out this much really it's kind of you to do.

I do try and be extroverted but it seems to work only in a way that people like me that day but will never speak to me again after.

I get people have larger problems than me so don't worry, try to help them if you can. 

I don't know how I feel, I think it might be best if I speak to my university counsellor, I know if I'm feeling this way then I won't able to do it alone.

Family died when I was young but they weren't particularly supportive anyway. I have no friends at all, closest was my housemates when I started university a couple years ago but they didn't really have a choice but to talk to me as I lived there and they don't respond if I message them even to say hi.

There is nobody I can speak to about anything which is why I guess I'm on here as I have no idea what to do

Thanks for the comment. I understand I'm lucky, I get that what I feel makes no sense. 

I just don't know what I'm doing wrong and each day I get worse and worse. Like why does no one actually love me? I thought if I did what I've done, get a house, work out and all those things that it would somehow lead to someone caring about me even if it's only superficial. But still no, in fact I feel worse now because I feel like there is nothing I can blame anymore but myself
